feeds.title: Imagination Soup Blog
feeds.description: Imagination Soup, curated by Melissa Taylor, serves as a hub for parents, librarians, and educators seeking great books and educational resources. As a mom, teacher, and literacy advocate, Melissa's expertise shines through her blog. With a background in education and freelance writing for prestigious clients like Random House and Scholastic, she champions literacy and representation in children's literature. Imagination Soup fosters a vibrant community dedicated to high-quality education and children's literacy.

feeds.title: The Denver Housewife
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jamie! I'm a SAHM mom to 4 rambunctious kids, 2 kitties, and my husband. I love all things crafty, yummy, fun, and pretty. The Denver Housewife is my place to share things to help other parents navigate life with kids through yummy recipes, fun crafts, cool products, and places to travel.

feeds.title: We Got The Funk
feeds.description: Hey There! We're the Funk's! We are a 30 something couple, with 2 awesome kids living our best life in Colorado. We enjoy life in Colorado, delicious food, and any DIY or home renovations that we can get our hands-on. Follow along as we create this lifestyle while parenting in picture-perfect chaos.

feeds.title: Building Our Story
feeds.description: Welcome, I'm Censie! I am a Denver Colorado blogger, mother of 2 who loves sharing inspiration as we continue to Build Our Story! Follow our family in Colorado as I chat about family-life, good reads, travel adventures, and yummy eats!

feeds.title: Pura Vida Moms
feeds.description: Pura Vida Moms is a personal blog that focuses on traditional Costa Rican food and travel to Costa Rica with kids. Christa Jimenez is a family travel blogger and bilingual mom, who now works as a recipe developer, and food and travel photographer. She provides her expertise & services on travel.

feeds.title: Lavender Luz Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lori Holden. A Wonderer, Wife, Mom, Author & Speaker. LavenderLuz is my blog where I share my thoughts on open adoption, parenting, yoga, living mindfully, thinking critically, and whatever else I'm on fire about to share with you.

feeds.title: Olive You Whole Blog
feeds.description: Caroline Fausel has always loved nutrition. After many bouts of vegetarianism, she and her husband found the Paleo lifestyle. After making the transition, they never felt better! Now with a better understanding of what makes us healthier, Caroline creates recipes for those striving to eat clean.

feeds.title: Mile High Mamas
feeds.description: Mile High Mamas was created as an entertaining community resource for Colorado moms. The site includes regular posts by some of Colorado's most popular mommy bloggers, events, family travel, activities, regular contests, restaurant picks, and product reviews.

feeds.title: Crunchy Beach Mama
feeds.description: My name is Courtney and I currently work at home with my 3 cuties. Each day I strive to become a more natural or Crunchy Mama by exploring through the blog lots of new ways and products focused on Healthy Living and Being Green.

feeds.title: With Love Lily Rose
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lily Rose. Denver feminine style blogger and influencer for the romantics at heart. I inspire women to dress up for their next social occasion, with a closet ever over-flowing with feminine pieces. Bringing a Southern twist and coastal vibes to rustic Colorado.

feeds.title: The Cashmere Gypsy
feeds.description: I'm Brittany. I'm a writer and editor, wife, mama to a sweet little girl, and hopelessly in love with pretty things. On my site, you'll discover fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and travel inspiration with a romantic and feminine twist.

feeds.title: Telecommuting Moms Blog
feeds.description: My name is Alaina and I am a stay-at-home, work-at-home, homeschooling mom of five wonderful kids here in Denver, Colorado. I am passionate about helping others avoid work-from-home scams and find real, legitimate ways to earn money from home. Hence, Telecommuting Moms provides information on a wide variety of legitimate work at home jobs to help you make ends meet as a Stay-at-Home Mom.

feeds.title: Chic Talk
feeds.description: Hi there! I´m Carolina Hellal, a Colombian living in Denver, CO. For four years I have been working full-time as the creative director of Chic Talk, a blog that focuses on my personal style, love of fashion, beauty advice, travel adventures, and new life as a mom.

feeds.title: Jessi Living Lovely
feeds.description: I'm Jessi! I'm excited to share with you my little corner of the internet. A bit of DIY, Family Fun, Travel, Wellness, inspiration, decor tips, and comfy/affordable shopping! But most importantly, a bit of community, and a lot of good laughs.

feeds.title: Greeblehaus
feeds.description: I'm Aimee Giese and I am a business owner, graphic designer, web developer, photographer, and blogger from Denver, Colorado. Greeblehaus primarily posts about concerts, music, travel, events, and tech. We like to have fun, and we hope you enjoy spending your time online with us.
